verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at deel.com (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. However, it is a parent-level Deel file describing the overall HR/payroll platform, and the evidence does not show it covers Immigration-specific content. No other agent-oriented docs are evidenced, and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers Immigration content, dedicated agent-oriented docs for Immigration, a machine-readable API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability.
